owner_request_2026_11_16_fourth.statement_summary: the separation must be real, it greatly improves Ketmix (a voice stops, the next song continues on the instrumental) as Apple Music does; the download is optional and must be optimised so that it is done only once and works quickly and smoothly; fix Ketvoice cutting out in the background; optimise the app and make video creation faster, with the sound (switchable).

done.stems_model: Spleeter 2 stems (Deezer, MIT) from the ONNX export of sherpa-onnx (SHA-256 pinned), converted to LiteRT with float16 weights by .github/workflows/publish-stem-models.yml (run 43880565743) and published as the ketmix-stems-v1 prerelease (not latest; the in-app updater ignores non-version tags); downloaded on request (39.4 MB) and checked against tools/stems/expected.sha256 / StemModel.kt; LiteRT 1.4.0 added to the APK
done.stems_engine: pure-Kotlin STFT (4096/1024 periodic Hann, as kaldi-native-fbank), sinc resampler, mask computation and inverse; the network runs on a low-priority thread once per title part (intro and ending, at most 50 s each), the mask is stored on 4 bits (filesDir/stems/masks, ~1 MB per title, 400 MB cap) and applied to a fresh silent capture of the deck's own sound at later mixes; decks cross-fade from the title to its instrumental under the existing vocalCut curves (now reaching full removal); without the model the 5.9.1 band cut stays; settings: model download/delete, separated songs count/size/clear, ketmixStemsCharging
done.background_cuts: network connection errors no longer burn through every source until playback stops: the same stream waits for connectivity (up to 3 min, 8 times per title) and resumes at its position; PlaybackJournal records service start/stop, task removal, focus losses, noisy events, errors and Android's ApplicationExitInfo reasons, shown and shareable in Settings; shortcut to manufacturer battery managers (Xiaomi, Huawei/Honor, Oppo/OnePlus/Realme, Vivo, Samsung) with manifest queries; Canvas players no longer decode audio
done.lyrics_video: Canvas frames decoded sequentially with getFramesAtIndex in batches of 8 (5.9.2 seeked with OPTION_CLOSEST for each of up to 150 frames), per-frame Paint/Path/text allocations removed, encoder polled instead of waited; optional sound (lyricVideoSound, on by default): MediaExtractor + MediaCodec decode of the chosen window from the downloaded file or progressive stream, 250 ms fades, AAC-LC 192 kb/s muxed before the video samples; DASH sources get a silent video

stems_validation.reference: 60 s of a commercial song (local only, not committed) separated by sherpa-onnx 2.0.1 (fp16 Spleeter)

known_limitations: Voice separation needs the optional 39 MB model; without it the voice is only softened.
Only the intro and the ending of a title (at most 50 s each) are separated; a mix beyond them falls back to softening the voice there.
The first mix of a title computes its separation while the mix is prepared; if it is not ready in time, that mix softens the voice and the next one uses the separation.
Lyrics videos of titles streamed as DASH have no sound.
The signing certificate is the existing public Android debug identity, not a private production key.
